extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: monster truck, approx. 4.5 x 2.9 x 2.6 m (L x W x H incl. light bar), tire diameter 1.6 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 giant wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); visible suspension with coil springs, shocks and solid axles; hollow cabin with transparent windows; no brand, no text, no flames

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
